title: Release 0.9.3: version bump, promote, release.yml publish:false for e2e qualification, then publish on the user's approval
description: 0.9.3 ships LCLI-575 (#245, query-augmented agent context; agent.context.export schemaVersion 2; help --json kindSchemaVersions) and LCLI-571 (#254, README quickstart fixed and gated). Scope per the orchestrator ranking of 2026-09-25T01:30:38Z, re-confirmed after LCLI-582 was filed (kept out). Same sequence as LCLI-577: (1) one version-metadata bump commit on dev, the #242 recipe; (2) promote to main; (3) release.yml publish:false at that SHA, run id and tarball sha256s to opum-cli-e2e; (4) e2e qualification receipt, recorded here (LCLI-578's reader is not built yet, so it is hand-checked as 0.9.2's was); (5) publication is the user's decision; (6) tag, GH release, marketplace handshake (LCLI-469) in two messages.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bump commit on dev covers every version site #242 touched, with bun test, typecheck, lint and bun run lore check green on its PR run
dev promoted to main at the bump SHA as a fast-forward
release.yml run with publish:false at that SHA is green; run id and sha256s sent to opum-cli-e2e
opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt received and recorded here (SHA, run id, tarball digests)
Publication decided by the user; if published, registry latest=0.9.3 on all seven packages and marketplace handshake sent
